## Hypothesis

H1. Participants will give less corrective comments compared to reinforcing comments.

H2. Participants will be more discerning when giving corrective comments compared to reinforcing ones.

H3. Participants will be more confident in their credibility assessment

1.  a\. when giving comments compared to skipping.

2.  b\. when giving corrective comments compared to reinforcing.

## Analysis using simulated data

```{r}
simData <- read.csv('simData.csv')
```

#### H1 - Out of the corrective comments only a small proportion is given online compared to reinforcing comments.

```{r}
simData$onlineResponse <- factor(simData$onlineResponse, levels = c('yes','no'))
table(simData$percCredibility, simData$onlineResponse)
```

```{r}
prop.test(table(simData$percCredibility, simData$onlineResponse))
```

```{r}
power.prop.test(p1 = 0.13, p2 = 0.19, sig.level = 0.05, power = 0.8)
```

#### H2 - Participants will be more discerning when giving corrective comments compared to reinforcing ones. (Ie - there will be more hits compared to misses to perceived false headlines as opposed to perceived true headlines. )

```{r}
table(simData$groundTruth, simData$percCredibility)
```

```{r}
simData <- simData %>% mutate(classification = ifelse( groundTruth == 'False' & percCredibility == 'p.False', 'hit', ifelse(groundTruth == 'False' & percCredibility != 'p.False', 'miss',ifelse(groundTruth == 'True' & percCredibility == 'p.True', 'hit','miss'))))
temp <- simData %>% filter(onlineResponse == 'yes')

table(simData$percCredibility, simData$classification)
```

```{r}
table(temp$groundTruth, temp$percCredibility)
```

```{r}
table(temp$percCredibility, temp$classification)
```

```{r}
prop.test(table(temp$percCredibility, temp$classification))
```

#### H3 - Participants will be more confident in their credibility assessment

1.  a\. when giving comments compared to skipping.

2.  b\. when giving corrective comments compared to reinforcing.

```{r}
simData %>% select(percCredibility,onlineResponse, confidence) %>% group_by(percCredibility, onlineResponse) %>% summarise(mConf = mean(confidence), sd = sd(confidence), count = n())
```

```{r}
rep.Aov <- aov(confidence ~ percCredibility * onlineResponse, data = simData)
summary(rep.Aov)

TukeyHSD(rep.Aov)
```

```{r}
etaSquared(rep.Aov)
```
